verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant connect directly to the workspace, with scoped permissions (add/remove capabilities), IP allowlisting, and concrete supported actions like listing audits, evidence requests, and adding comments (thoropass-docs-1,2,3,19,20,28,29; thoropass-probe-2). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server beyond vendor docs, and no detail on transport/auth standards compliance.
